description: Lipo-C with B12 is the same lipotropic liquid formulation with cyanocobalamin included as the cobalamin component. As with the plain Lipo-C, the exact component list and concentrations are stated on the batch Certificate of Analysis rather than fixed in the catalogue.

faq.question: How does Lipo-C with B12 differ from plain Lipo-C?
faq.answer: It is the same lipotropic vehicle with cyanocobalamin included as the cobalamin component, which gives the solution its red tint and makes light protection more important.

faq.question: Why is no CAS number listed?
faq.answer: The product is a blend of several components, so no single CAS number applies; composition is documented per batch on the Certificate of Analysis.

faq.question: Does the B12 content change storage requirements?
faq.answer: Yes — cyanocobalamin is photolabile, so the solution must be stored at 2–8 °C protected from light and should not be left exposed during handling.

faq.question: Can the B12 concentration be adjusted?
faq.answer: Custom component concentrations are available for OEM orders when a written specification is agreed in advance.

faq.question: What bulk pricing applies?
faq.answer: Pricing is per 10-vial kit with tiered wholesale discounts from 10% at 5+ kits to 30% at 50+ kits, combined across your order.
